# CTO Jobs HQ

> CTO Jobs HQ is the #1 job board for CTO and technology leadership roles. Find and post top CTO jobs, discover companies, and connect with recruiters.

CTO Jobs HQ is a curated platform for technology leaders. We focus on quality, relevance, and transparency. All jobs are manually reviewed before being listed.

Founded by Jeroen Roosenboom as a companion to Find Your CTO, a reversed job board for Fractional CTOs. CTO Jobs HQ serves technical leaders seeking their next executive opportunity.

## What We Offer

- Curated CTO and technology leadership job listings (full-time, fractional, contract, advisory)
- Weekly newsletter with the latest CTO opportunities
- Recruitment agency directory for companies hiring CTOs
- Blog with insights on CTO hiring trends and career advice
- Free job listings + featured paid placements for employers

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://ctojobshq.com/): Main landing page
- [All Jobs](https://ctojobshq.com/jobposts): Browse all active CTO jobs
- [Featured Jobs](https://ctojobshq.com/featured-jobs): Premium featured CTO positions
- [Companies](https://ctojobshq.com/companies): List of hiring companies
- [Recruitment Agencies](https://ctojobshq.com/cto-recruitment-agency): For employers looking for specialized CTO recruitment agencies
- [About](https://ctojobshq.com/about): About CTO Jobs HQ
- [Contact](https://ctojobshq.com/contact): Contact us
- [Custom Projects](https://ctojobshq.com/custom_projects): Do you want a job board like this or a custom project?
- [Blog](https://ctojobshq.com/blog): Insights and advice for CTOs and technical leaders
- [Pricing](https://ctojobshq.com/pricing): Job posting packages for employers

## Technical Details

- All job posts are manually reviewed
- Jobs include structured JobPosting schema markup (schema.org)
- RSS feed available for latest jobs
- XML sitemaps available for all content types
